scientific_question: Can the complete geometry-coupled nine-camera pattern of leave-one-camera-out drift and per-camera Low-64 fit residual support a fail-closed direct-K11 fallback when the two scalar maxima cannot?
role: post-open development diagnostic on already opened BLASTNet Cases 5 and 2

conditions.name: blastnet_case5
conditions.role: known-safe one-class fit and leave-one-rig-out calibration

observable_before_truth_barrier.per_camera_drift: norm of the full-response change after deleting camera j and refitting Low-64, divided by the full fitted-response norm
observable_before_truth_barrier.per_camera_residual: camera-block Low-64 fit-residual norm divided by the corresponding observation-block norm

primary_representation.name: geometry-coupled angular spectrum
primary_representation.direction_source: first three reported camera-token entries, normalized as world-frame unit view direction
channels: camera drift divided by its nine-camera L2 norm
camera residual divided by its nine-camera L2 norm
their pointwise product divided by its nine-camera L2 norm
primary_representation.zero_mass_rule: If a channel L2 norm is no larger than 1e-12, its normalized nine-camera row is deterministically all zero; otherwise divide by that norm.
primary_representation.embedding: sum over active cameras of angular_basis outer channels divided by sqrt(active_camera_count)

one_class_policy.feature_scale: component RMS over fit rows with the sole positive finite floor 1e-12
one_class_policy.distance: Euclidean RMS distance after fixed fit scaling
one_class_policy.local_radius: for each fit row, distance to its nearest fit row from a different rig
one_class_policy.query_rule: accept direct K11 iff query distance to its nearest fit row is no larger than that fit row's local cross-rig radius
one_class_policy.case5_evaluation: 13 leave-one-rig-out fits; each held-out rig is absent from scaling, library and local radii
one_class_policy.case2_evaluation: one fit on all Case5 rows; Case2 truth unavailable until decisions are sealed

truth_visible_adjudication.safe_definition: Direct Low-64 PCGLS K11 passes every frozen absolute per-cell gate and every ratio to Zero-PCGLS K16 is at most 1.05
truth_visible_adjudication.utility_reason: 10 percent direct acceptance implies at least 2.8125 percent total logical exact-call reduction versus 16A+16At in every rig

truth_visible_capacity_labels.truth_role: Truth and reference metrics are deserialized only after primary/control features and all one-class policy decisions have been exclusively sealed.

independent_validation.second_feature_solver: normal-matrix eigendecomposition rather than formal response SVD
independent_validation.second_distance_path: explicit row loops rather than formal Gram-vectorized pairwise distances

decision_order: invalid execution or independent mismatch -> INCONCLUSIVE
primary safety, per-rig utility, physical accuracy, or per-rig cost failure -> close the angular-spectrum mutual-support policy
primary pass and cheap control pass -> control explains the development headroom
primary pass and cheap control fail -> post-open multiview development headroom only
